dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, do you eat breakfast every day?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, duː juː ˈiːt ˈbrɛkfəst ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not always. I often skip breakfast because I get up late.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈɔːlweɪz. aɪ ˈɔːfən ˈskɪp ˈbrɛkfəst bɪˈkɔːz aɪ ˈɡɛt ˈʌp ˈleɪt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: It's important to eat three meals a day.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ɪmˈpɔːrtənt tə ˈiːt ˈθriː ˈmiːlz ə ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Is it really necessary to eat breakfast?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ɪt ˈriːli ˈnɛsəsɛri tə ˈiːt ˈbrɛkfəst?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes. It's hard to study when you're hungry.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ɪts ˈhɑːrd tə ˈstʌdi wɛn jʊr ˈhʌŋɡri.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's right. And I always feel sleepy after lunch.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈraɪt. ənd aɪ ˈɔːlweɪz ˈfiːl ˈsliːpi ˈæftər ˈlʌntʃ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: It's OK to take a nap for twenty minutes. But it's better not to drink coffee in the afternoon.
dialogue.reading: ɪts oʊˈkeɪ tə ˈteɪk ə ˈnæp fər ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts. bʌt ɪts ˈbɛtər ˈnɑːt tə ˈdrɪŋk ˈkɔːfi ɪn ði ˌæftərˈnuːn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And water? How much should I drink?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈwɔːtər? ˈhaʊ ˈmʌtʃ ʃʊd aɪ ˈdrɪŋk?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: It's a good idea to drink eight glasses a day. Here's a free water bottle for you!
dialogue.reading: ɪts ə ˈɡʊd aɪˈdiːə tə ˈdrɪŋk ˈeɪt ˈɡlæsɪz ə ˈdeɪ. hɪrz ə ˈfriː ˈwɔːtər ˌbɑːtəl fər juː!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thank you! I'll take it to class every day.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː! aɪl ˈteɪk ɪt tə ˈklæs ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ.
